Subject: April/May billing cutover — invoice timing

Hi Irene / Laura,

As part of NovaCloud's April->May billing cutover we saw a cluster of invoices that hit our AR on 2027-04-30 but were reissued with May settlement terms. That shifted recognition and created a small timing gap in your AR aging — NovaCloud reports ~€128k of invoices showing in our system as unpaid for May but marked paid in Redwood's ledger on 2027-04-30.

Can you confirm whether Redwood recorded the April invoices as 'billed' in April revenue maps or if they were deferred at month-end? We need to agree on: 1) the proper revenue recognition mapping, and 2) any adjusting journals to align both ledgers before month close.

Attached is our export of the affected invoices (by customer id and invoice id).

Thanks,
Martin Lee
Finance Manager — NovaCloud

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Cc: NovaCloud Finance <finance@novacloud.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:15:00Z
Subject: Re: April/May billing cutover — invoice timing

Thanks Martin — pulled the ledger slice and did a line-level compare. High-level findings (draft):

- Total mismatch: €127,943 across 18 invoice lines.
- 12 invoices: Redwood recorded as billed on 2027-04-30 and recognized into April revenue (rev_map: STANDARD_MONTHLY).
- 6 invoices: reissued in May on NovaCloud with new ids; payments posted in May.

Recommendation options:
1) Post adjusting journal entries to move the 12 April-recognized invoices from April to May revenue (debit AR credit Revenue) — requires accounting approval and will affect month-over-month revenue.
2) Have NovaCloud issue credit memos for the 6 duplicates and we apply the credits — preserves Redwood recognition but relies on NovaCloud ops.

I've attached a working workbook with the matched rows and a proposed journal template (sheet 'JRN_PROPOSAL'). If we go with option (1) we need a formal sign-off from Finance leadership and a GL posting date (proposed 2027-06-03).

Attachments: ar_review_draft.xlsx (workbook)

Laura Bennett
Manager, Revenue Accounting
Redwood Inference

Forwarding Laura's draft with my notes inline. TL;DR: I support Option (1) with a constrained, auditable journal so our revenue recognition aligns with cash/settlement dates on NovaCloud's side. Key items:

- Journal entry reference: JRN-4982 (proposed).
- Scope: only the 12 invoices currently recognized in April that have newer, confirmed settlement in May on NovaCloud's export. Do NOT adjust invoices where payment was actually received in April.
- Controls: include per-invoice supporting rows in Workday and attach NovaCloud settlement evidence.

On controls: Grace, can you confirm posting window and whether we should set the GL date to 2027-05-31 or 2027-06-03? My preference is 2027-06-03 so we can include late-settlement evidence through 2027-05-31.

On audit trail: I'll prepare a PDF export of the workbook with the matched rows and include it in the JRN ticket; see attached draft PDF.

Marcus Lin
